sections.title: Font origin and number style check
sections.what: Confirms the chosen font is loaded, no outside requests are made for fonts or other resources, and number text uses the even-width style.
sections.why: Protects visitor privacy and keeps numbers readable in tables and scores.
sections.watch_out: The check looks at every outside request, so any future third-party script on the login page will fail it.

summary: Browser test that checks the page's fonts load from the app's own address and that numbers use the even-width number style.
purpose: Confirms fonts are served by the app, not a third-party service, and that numbers line up.
why: Loading fonts from outside would leak visitor data to another company, and misaligned numbers hurt scores and tables.
how: It records every outside request the login page makes, confirms the chosen font is ready, and expects no outside requests apart from inline data. It then creates a test number element and checks its computed style uses tabular numerals.
inputs: The login page and its font settings.
outputs: Pass or fail for the font source check and the numeral style.
risks: A legitimate new asset served from outside the app would fail this check until it is moved in-house.
debug: If the outside request check fails, the list shows the address. Move that resource inside the app or update the policy consciously.
